nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_84
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the trace(s) find that the player is at a reasonable height relative to the wall, record the player\'s z-location as the last known safe height and perform no further action.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_81
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Perform different actions depending on whether the trace finds an eligible wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_79
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
This function identifies if there is enough space on the wall near the top of the player\'s capsule for the character to latch on to. If there isn\'t enough room, we either:\r
\r
1. Prevent the wall run if one hasn\'t already begun\r
2. If we are already wall-running, prevent the player from running up and off of the wall\'s top ledge (this could occur when the wall-run is arcing upwards, or if the ledge angles downward into the wall-run\'s path)\r
\r
We start with a simple line trace because it\'s the least prone to giving false positives. The trace starts at the desired "max height" that the player\'s capsule should be relative to the top ledge of a wall (i.e. if the trace doesn\'t hit the wall, it suggests the player has gone too high), then moves towards the wall a short distance.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_10
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the failsafe trace finds the ledge, record how far below the desired height it is.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_9
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the previous trace doesn\'t detect a wall, it means the character moved up a significant distance from the previous frame (most likely due to extremely low FPS), causing us to lose the wall entirely. If this happens, perform a failsafe trace that tries to find the top ledge of the wall by starting above it and tracing downwards. This will rarely ever be used unless your framerate drops to near unplayable levels.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_8
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: In the event that the line trace fails to detect a wall, we perform a backup capsule trace. The additional size of this capsule trace is more likely to find where the top ledge of the wall is, but that also means it\'s more likely to find false positives, which is why this is only done if the first trace fails.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_6
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Perform different actions depending on whether the trace finds an eligible wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the impact point is below the trace\'s start location (indicating that the player is higher than desired), and the player is currently wall-running, lower the player by the difference (how high above the wall they are) to place them at the desired max height for the current wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the height check fails and the player is already wall-running, move the character down to the last recorded safe height.
